commands.review_summary:
The branch adds `error` handlers to the three Windows `taskkill.exe` spawns in `runCommandWithTimeout` so async taskkill start failures fall back to `child.kill("SIGKILL")`.

PR surface: Source +11. Total +11 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. for source-level reproduction: current main and the latest release show taskkill child spawns without `error` handlers, and Node documents failed spawns as `error` events rather than successful `spawn` events. No live Windows end-to-end run was performed in this read-only review. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/api/child_process.html))

target.title: fix(infra): enforce maxBytes in readResponseBodySnippet non-streaming fallback
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readResponseBodySnippet` in `src/infra/http-error-body.ts` has a non-streaming fallback path that previously called `response.text()` which would buffer the entire body before `maxBytes` could be applied — creating an OOM risk for large error responses on non-streaming transports.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the whole-body fallback with a **fail-closed** approach: when the response body has no `getReader` (non-streaming or mocked responses), return `` immediately instead of calling `response.text()`. The streaming path continues to enforce `maxBytes` via the bounded reader loop.

This follows the ClawSweeper recommendation: *"use a bounded stream source or fail closed before calling whole-body fallbacks."*

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof (8/8 PASS)

```
node --import tsx test/_proof_response_body_snippet_bound.mts

PASS  non-streaming fail-closed: returns empty string :: len=0
PASS  non-streaming small: also returns empty (fail-closed) :: got=""
PASS  streaming: snippet ≤ maxChars :: len=200 max=500
PASS  streaming: byte length ≤ maxBytes :: bytes=200 max=200
PASS  streaming small: passes through :: got="world"
PASS  streaming multibyte: bytes ≤ maxBytes :: bytes=15 max=15
PASS  streaming multibyte: chars ≤ maxChars :: chars=5 max=100
PASS  streaming multibyte: no replacement char :: snippet="啊啊啊啊啊"

[proof] 8 PASS, 0 FAIL
```

### Code change

The non-streaming fallback no longer calls `response.text()`:

```typescript
if (!body || typeof body.getReader !== "function") {
    // Fail closed: return empty rather than risk OOM on large bodies.
    return "";
}
```

## Issue

Fixes #101269
